name: Fabrizio Kevin Moningka
subtitle: Fullstack Developer • UI/Visual Design • AI & Automation

paragraphs: I'm a recent Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience building fullstack web applications independently — from database design and backend architecture to user interface development.
extendedParagraphs: I'm a recent Computer Science graduate from Universitas Klabat with hands-on experience building fullstack web applications independently — from database design and backend architecture, to user interface development, all the way to production deployment.

I'm comfortable working with Next.js, Node.js, and MySQL, and I have a strong interest in UI/visual design and applying AI & automation (n8n) in digital product development. My biggest project so far, a fullstack village information system, taught me how to think end-to-end: not just writing code, but designing secure authentication, protecting sensitive citizen data, and shipping to real production infrastructure.

Beyond web development, I'm Adobe-certified in visual design and genuinely enjoy the intersection of engineering and design — making sure the things I build are not just functional, but also feel good to use.
I'm a fast learner who's used to seeing projects through from planning to implementation without supervision, and I'm always looking for the next problem worth solving.
